description: This file defines a Controller class for handling customer-related API requests in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It primarily manages customer data validation, session login, and response for customer API calls.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class providing an API endpoint for customer data validation, retrieval, and session management in Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method handling the API request: validating input, loading customer and customer group information, validating custom fields, logging in the customer, and returning the result.
